Name: Customized Community Center - Pride Community Center Bundles
Author: plantsandprose
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/dQLCjmY/pride-community-center-bundles.png[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/pZjCL5K/a-content-mod-by-caps.png[/img][/center]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/0YPd0r2/overview.png[/img]
[size=3]These community center bundles and rewards were created and are themed around celebrating Pride in Stardew Valley! Modified vanilla bundles (ie. spring/summer/fall/winter forage) are reorganized and expanded to create pride and rainbow motifs across the entire Community Center. New bundles include the Pride Rally bundle, Prismatic Fishing bundle, Fruity bundle, and a variety of bundles designed with items around various pride flags. Pride doesn't end on June 30th in our world or in Pelican Town!
[/size]
[size=3]We have customized multiple versions of the community center for challenge runs. We will continue to provide updates on the other custom Community Centers we have created when those mods can also be posted.

[/size][img]https://i.ibb.co/Js9ZNMm/about.png[/img]
[/font][/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3]This mod was originally designed for use in a charity stream series by [i][url=https://www.twitch.tv/mallory]mallory[/url][/i]. This mod implements changes to the community center bundles to enhance the charity challenge run, allowing the completion of the Community Center to better support the themed challenge. The creator of this challenge, Mallory, [url=https://malschallengeruns.com/]has created a website[/url] for players interested in trying out challenges with additional free resources for creators and streamers.
[/size][/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]
[size=3]Players looking to complete these bundles should feel free to do so on their own time and for whatever reason they wish. Our team does consider this set of Community Center bundles to be considered "difficult," however, this does not suggest any requirements by which players choose to use these bundles in their own playthroughs or content and the mod has been uploaded for anyone looking to try out a customized Community Center regardless of their interest in any additional challenges.

[b]Please note[/b]: this mod was created with the intention to be celebratory of the LGBTQIA+ community and to be inclusive to as many members of the community as we could, however, we are mindful of the fact that this mod in no way represents all members of the community. If there are ways individuals believe we could make this mod better, please feel free to let us know!
[/size]
[size=3]Learn more at: [url=https://malschallengeruns.com/]malschallengeruns.com
[/url]

[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][img]https://i.ibb.co/KjyYksF/installation-guide.png[/img][/font][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3]Download and unzip [b]Challenging Community Center Bundles - Base Version[/b] (found in the [u]optional files[/u] section of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6361http://]Challenging Community Center Bundles mod[/url]﻿) and add all files to your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.[/size][/font][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3]Open the game. This will prompt SMAPI to generate a config file in the Challenging Community Center Bundles mod folder.[/size][/font][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3]Close out Stardew Valley after SMAPI has fully run and the Start Menu loads.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3]Download the custom community center for your desired challenge run.[/size][/font][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3]Unzip the files and move both the [CP] and [CCCB] folders to your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.[/size][/font][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3]Update the name of the bundle variant in your “ChallengingCommunityCenterBundles” config file to the name corresponding to your chosen community center.[/size][/font][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3]For the Pride Community Center Bundles you will use “Pride_Bundles”.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][b]NOTE:[/b] [i]It is not recommended to add this mod into an existing save file, as it may cause errors in SMAPI and is best suited to be installed prior to the creation of a new save file. It *may* work inside of a current save files but has been known to cause some errors when doing so. If you experience errors related to the bundles in a current save file, it is recommended to create a [/i][i]new file to use this mod.
 [/i]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/MS3WfGg/special-thanks.png[/img]
[size=3]The development of this mod would not have been possible without the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6361]Challenging Community Center Bundles[/url][size=3] mod by Alvadea and Jaksha. They created a wonderful framework which allows us to customize our community centers and have updated their mod to include a base version now in 1.6, making installation and usage of this mod even easier!

The banner graphic background (Stardew crops Pride Flag) was created by [url=https://www.twitch.tv/stelllajo]stelllajo[/url] ([url=https://x.com/stelllajo/status/1714096189954523431]Original post[/url]). Thank you for allowing us to use it here!
[/size]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/zR5wmxR/compatibility.png[/img]
[size=3]This bundle is compatible with all mods except those that also edit the community center sprites or bundle items.
[/size]
[s][size=3]There is a known incompatibility with [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url][/s][size=3][s], causing the bulletin board sprites to display incorrectly, however the sprites developed for this specific Community Center should have no issues if installed properly. Additionally, the actual bundle contents will display properly regardless of this mod.[/s] [i]Resolved as of 1.1.0[/i]
[/size]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/BZyTqB4/the-team.png[/img]
